subject: English
question_text: Read the following sentences and put them in correct order.
stimulus: (a) It was named after an English man named George Everest. (b) There might be snow slides and cracks under ice and snow. (c) Mount Everest has always fascinated climbers. (d) Mount Everest is in the Himalayan Mountains. (e) Is in-the north of India, between Tibet and Nepal. (f) He was the first to survey the Himalayas. (g) It is difficult and dangerous because there is snow all over. (h) But climbing the Everest is difficult and dangerous.
guide_solution: d → e → a → f → c → h → g → b
